title: Blood & Concrete *PART 10*
author: Dangerous_Charge_518
selftext:
Youtube episode 10!

For so many years I've been trying to make a remake of Gangsters: Organized Crime, and so often I got demotivated or distracted by side quests. As an indie developer you need so many skills, and I actually have very little time because I have a full-time job and a family, but still I've been working on it for months. The Coding is intergrated within Unity by ClaudeAI terminal.

Please check it out and let me know if you see potential to make it a fun game. My goal is not to make money (profit) with it; the hours I spend on it are pure hobby and fun.

I have overcome my own challenges by staying motivated, and that is what counts as a great victory for me. Let me know what you want to keep or what needs to be changed—I love feedback!

Thanks for reading and your time.
